field_guide.candidate_events: VIRAT annotation kept as candidate atomic events. Do not merge on temporal overlap alone.
field_guide.review.decision: null until reviewed. Then KEEP, EXCLUDE, or GROUP.
field_guide.review.visibility: unreviewed until a person sets high, medium, or low.
field_guide.review.captionable: null until a person sets true or false.
field_guide.review.include_primary_eval: null until a person sets true or false.
field_guide.review.semantic_location: Place name written by a person. screen_location is only a frame-grid bin.
field_guide.track_motion: Endpoint displacement of the subject track. Not a required caption slot.
field_guide.duplicate_candidate: Same subject track, same activity class, and overlap covering at least 80% of the shorter interval. Members stay as separate candidates. A person chooses which one to keep.
field_guide.same_actor_different_activity: Do not merge. Exit plus carry, or carry plus enter, remain separate events.
field_guide.different_spatial_region: Concurrent events in different regions stay separate. Do not merge them.
field_guide.screen_bins: left_bottom, left_middle, and the other 3x3 bins are screen_location only. They are not an event-grouping criterion.
field_guide.grouping: Do not create a group from 3x3 bins. A people-group, if a person adds one, is for a general action such as walking and must not absorb enter, exit, carry, run, or vehicle actions.
field_guide.human_added_events: Actions outside the VIRAT 12 classes are added here by a person. Leave empty until then.
field_guide.carrying_without_object_track: Carrying candidates with no mapped object track are captioned as person, not carrying. The VIRAT activity_class stays person_carrying_object. Carrying candidates that have an object track are unchanged.

evidence.note: Computed from annotation time and track displacement. 3x3 screen bins are not a grouping criterion. Not a visibility or captionability label.

grouping_policy.duplicate_rule: same subject track, same activity class, shorter interval coverage >= 0.8
